project.title: Beilinson–Bloch Heights and the Strong Zero-Curvature Green Conjecture
project.subtitle: Actual Green forms, canonical pairings, and arithmetic finiteness
project.summary: The actual-form and height foundations have internal proofs in their stated scope. The normalized pairing is constructed on all local obstruction kernels; Strong Green still supplies the conditional route to the full homologically trivial Chow groups.
project.motivation:
Beilinson–Bloch heights extend the arithmetic information of heights on curves to homologically trivial cycles in higher codimension. The goal is a canonical real pairing on both full complementary rational Chow groups in arbitrary dimension.

The principal approach is Strong Green: actual zero-curvature Green forms over the original local field, on the prescribed exact support complement and against all compact actual tests. Theorem 7.5 gives the full pairing from Strong G at every finite completion in both complementary degrees, using the analytic foundations proved in Propositions 2.1–2.7.

The Chow obstruction, prescribed curved pairs, finite trace, covariance and height on all local kernels have internal proofs. General homological vanishing remains open. Identification with a fixed finite-test kernel, general admissible liftings, positivity and finiteness are separate questions.
project.programme: The actual Chow obstruction, prescribed curved Green pairs, full finite trace and height construction on all local kernels have internal proofs. The remaining construction questions concern general homological source-image vanishing, identification with fixed finite tests, and admissible liftings on general arithmetic models. The properties strand separates curve-visible abelian contributions from the residual Griffiths quotient. Positivity, integral lattices, fields of definition and general bad-reduction comparisons remain distinct research problems.
